svg.title: Dry-room receiving and controlled drying context
svg.desc: A receiving workflow linking correct lot and rack identity, quantity and condition records, environmental context, product condition, and escalation, while emphasizing that drying is monitored rather than a universal fixed-day countdown.

g.text: Controlled drying is evidence-based, not calendar-only
Drying rate changes with material density, load, temperature, RH, airflow and product condition.
Record the identified rack/lot and supplied environmental/product evidence at its actual scope.
Meaningful deviation → document + escalate. Do not declare completion from a universal day count or independently redesign protected controls.
One nonuniform rack or container is documented at that location before anyone generalizes the condition to the room or lot.
